body: M5 is landed and COMPLETE - spec and all seven boards are on master alongside M4's six (M4 landed earlier in 20a5d29, so nothing was waiting). Your EXTENDED grid call is accepted as written: consensus keeps M4's score weight, judges are secondary ordinal mini-columns in the old gutter, median_card never an average, labels ordinal only. Swing stays a warm hinge and never gold. Recorded in HANDOFF. NEXT: TASK M6 - THE HOLD: A BODY THAT CANNOT BE BOOKED. research/TASK_M6.md. M4 and M5 dressed the night a fight ends; this dresses the eight weeks after. John's J3 ruled the medical layer the number one thing to build next, and landing it turned up that most of the state already exists - the engine says cannot be booked in six places and not one of them looks like anything. It is a state a body is in, not an error, and that distinction is the whole brief. Engine-true and every number is in the task file: six regions, three bands (green 80 / amber 60 / red), and TWO clearances that disagree on purpose - training wants every region at 80, competition wants head_neck 90, torso_core 85, limbs 80, plus fatigue at most 85. A fighter cleared to train and refused a fight is the normal case. Five typed refusals with their own numbers, and they stack. Deliver: the hold badge family (held / not cleared / cleared) readable in a roster row, the six-region body read showing both thresholds at once, the refusal said properly, the roster at a glance, the week the hold lifts, honest empties, and an explicit board of the anti-pattern you rejected. Continuity: M1/M2 Cage Desk tokens, M4/M5 chrome, gold x1 is spent elsewhere so nothing here takes it, GO is CONTINUE only, and you decide whether a hold takes the doctor's BAD or amber - write the reason down. FORBIDDEN: diagnoses, injury names, anatomy illustration, a doctor as a character, and any invented region, band, threshold, hold length or recovery rate. Anything the engine lacks is labelled DESIGNED AHEAD, as you did in M5. Boards go in a NEW folder DesignLibrary/screens/medical/ as m6_*.png. Art only - no .gd/.tscn/HANDOFF/assets/data; I write your block and mark the task done. Model: top tier, effort medium, Fast off. Send ART READY M6 when pushed.
topic: M5 landed - TASK M6 assigned: the hold
